repos_data.description: Understand any codebase in 60 seconds - an MCP server, CLI and GitHub Action that turns any repo into an architecture diagram (Mermaid/Graphviz) and enforces architecture rules in CI. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client.
Stops your AI coding agent from writing calls to functions that don't exist, before the edit lands. Deterministic, no LLM, no API keys.
